title: BioVAT merge pipeline parameters
description: Merge alignments to library level or to sample level with samtools

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data.

samplesheet.description: Alignments samplesheet (CSV) with the columns sample, library_id, platform, single_end, alignment and index. library_id is needed to merge to library level and can be empty at sample level.

alignments.description: Alternative to --samplesheet: a YAML or JSON file with one entry per alignment. Fields: meta (a map with id, pl, single_end and, for library level, library), alignment (BAM/CRAM file) and index (its index). Use either --samplesheet or --alignments.

level.description: Merge level. Alignments are grouped by sample and library (library) or by sample (sample).

fasta.description: Reference fasta file. Needed for CRAM output and Riker.

fai.description: Fai index of the reference fasta. Used by CRAM output and Riker. Created from --fasta when it is needed and not given.

alignment_qc_options.title: Alignment QC options
alignment_qc_options.description: Quality checks on the output alignments.

cram_format.description: Write CRAM instead of BAM. Requires --fasta and --fai.

align_qc.description: Run quality checks on the output alignments.

riker.description: Run Riker in the alignment QC. Requires --fasta and --fai.

qualimap.description: Run Qualimap in the alignment QC. Not compatible with --cram_format.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
